**Review: Assam Breakfast product page**

**Claims list**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "A malty, full-bodied black tea" | Product/flavour fact, fine as written |
| "noticeably smoother than supermarket tea bags" | **Unsupported.** This is a comparison with no evidence on the allowlist. "Noticeably" asserts a measurable difference, and "supermarket tea bags" is an unnamed, unbounded comparator. It fails the "compared to what?" test. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted |
| "100g tin" | Product fact (size), fine |
| "makes around 40 cups" | Brewing/size fact, fine. "Around" keeps it soft. |

**Slop and structure check:** no banned vocabulary, no rhetorical opener, no em-dash sandwiches, no exclamation marks. The opening is a product name, which is acceptable on a product page.

**Fix:** cut the comparison. Replace it with a concrete description of the tea itself, for example "A malty, full-bodied black tea with a rounded finish" (only if that matches the actual tasting notes). If you want to keep the comparison, it needs a source, such as a blind taste test you can cite, in which case it would go in as `[PROOF NEEDED: taste test or other evidence for smoother-than-supermarket claim]`.

**Suggested compliant copy:**
Assam Breakfast. A malty, full-bodied black tea. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 100g tin, makes around 40 cups.

**Verdict:** do not publish until the comparison is removed or sourced.

{"issues": [{"quote": "noticeably smoother than supermarket tea bags", "type": "superlative"}], "publish": false}
